ComfyUI 工作流程 | ControlNet Tile 和 4x UltraSharp 用于高分辨率修复

你可以轻松运行这个ComfyUI 高分辨率修复工作流程在舒适UI云，专门为ComfyUI量身定制的平台。所有必要的节点和模型均已预设并可立即使用！您还可以在这里找到许多其他出色的 ComfyUI 工作流程。

此 ComfyUI 升级工作流程可增强视频质量，首先使用 AnimeDiff 进行初始创建，然后使用 ControlNet Tile Upscale 提高分辨率和细节准确性。该方法在基于分段的升级方面表现出色。包含 4x UltraSharp Model Upscale 可确保增强清晰度和细节，在不丢失细节的情况下实现高分辨率结果。此外，每个升级阶段的帧插值都提高了视频质量，展示了 ComfyUI 高分辨率视频增强的集成方法。

ControlNet 平铺

ControlNet Tile Upscale 使用 ControlNet 模型填充缺失或不一致的细节来增强图像分辨率。它巧妙地处理输入和图像特征之间的差异，非常适合基于分段的升级，提供高质量、详细的图像。

4x UltraSharp 升频器

4x UltraSharp Upscaler 提高了图像分辨率，具有卓越的清晰度和细节，解决了放大过程中的细节丢失问题，并为图像增强设定了基准。

ComfyUI Workflow | ControlNet Tile and 4x UltraSharp for Hi-Res Fix

You can easily run thisComfyUI Hi-Res Fix WorkflowinComfyUI Cloud, a platform tailored specifically for ComfyUI. All essential nodes and models are pre-set and ready for immediate use! And you'll find plenty of other great ComfyUI Workflows here.

This ComfyUI upscaling workflow enhances video quality starting with AnimeDiff for initial creation, followed by ControlNet Tile Upscale for improving resolution and detail accuracy. This method excels in segment-based upscaling. The inclusion of a 4x UltraSharp Model Upscale ensures enhanced clarity and detail, achieving high-resolution results without losing detail. Additionally, frame interpolation at each upscaling stage boosts video quality, showcasing ComfyUI's integrated approach to high-resolution video enhancement.

ControlNet Tile

ControlNet Tile Upscale enhances image resolution using a ControlNet model to fill in missing or inconsistent details. It skillfully handles differences between the input and image features, ideal for segment-based upscaling, delivering high-quality, detailed images.

4x UltraSharp Upscaler

The 4x UltraSharp Upscaler improves image resolution with exceptional clarity and detail, addressing the issue of detail loss in upscaling processes, and setting a benchmark for image enhancement.
